blocks.text: DSPM provides visibility and security for SaaS applications used in your organizations. You can integrate application tenants with DSPM to monitor and scan the data stores within the SaaS applications, apply the Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) labels to on-premises Azure file shares, or integrate with Microsoft Copilot.

You can view the scan results of the SaaS applications on the SaaS Overview dashboard. The dashboard displays the detected incidents, showing their distribution and identifying affected applications and users.
Support for scanning SaaS applications provides the following key benefits and allows you to:

blocks.item: Detect sensitive data, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities in data stores.
Apply the Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) labels.

blocks.text: On the SaaS Applications page (Data Security > DSPM > SaaS Applications), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the list of all configured SaaS tenants. For each tenant, you can see:
Tenant Name: The name of the SaaS tenant.
Tenant ID: The ID of the SaaS tenant.
Authentication Mode: The authentication type (e.g., Client Secret, Certificate) selected for the tenant.
Status: The status of the onboarded tenant.
Successfully Configured: The tenant is configured and validated successfully.
Needs Attention: The tenant configuration has failed (e.g., invalid client secret or certificate).
Status Details: The details of the status. This is available only for tenants with the Needs Attention status.
Last Validated: The last time the SaaS tenant was validated.
Added On: The date and time the SaaS tenant was added.
Added By: The user who onboarded the tenant.
